scope: Source, sealed documentation and synthetic fixtures only; no real collections/results, numerical model/trajectory payloads or remote calls.

findings.title: Bind cell failure metadata to the saved row
findings.detail: The committed-cell gate matches row status but not cell.failure to row.failure. Existing synthetic collection with a valid failed row at forecast11/graph and an invented cell category/forecast0/phase passed and emitted contradictory cells versus row_checks. Require exact retained failure identity for recorded_failed_outcome and an appropriate no-failure predicate for completed cells.

findings.title: Verify per-model coverage and failure-category summaries
findings.detail: Only pooled rollout coverage is reconstructed; full_rollout is extensible in supported_equal so coverage_by_model is ignored. An in-memory synthetic mutation changing base0 from180completed cells to180failed with an invented category passed, while a pooled-coverage mutation was rejected. Reconstruct model/stage counts and categories from failure-bound audited cells.

scope_notes: Published failed_accepted_prefixes is currently ignored by companion; individual prefix arithmetic is checked by main. Either verify the listing or state this explicit limit.

One NPZ row is materialized together with its compressed bytes; no fixed decompressed-size cap exists. This matches documented one-row-at-a-time scope rather than a constant memory guarantee. Sequential A/B execution and preserved OOM/timeout outcomes remain necessary.
Source and read-input hashes are rechecked through output serialization. Execution must use the sealed source bytes; the scripts do not replace root source admission.
arithmetic_review: Saved forecast1/10/50/200/395 errors and available boundaries match formulas; unsaved-step aggregates are accurately described as scalar-series arithmetic.
Diagnostic residual normalization, vector benefits, sign fractions, average-rank Spearman, variance floor/NLL, timing sample SD and incoming-support physical RMS agree with frozen source.

Three-seed means/sample SD, within-arm differences, mix-minus-base and difference-of-differences signs and null propagation agree. Nonzero synthetic controls independently confirmed the interaction signs.
